description_expanded: Description Description 30A ESCAPES presents… “Casa Sole”, a brand new luxury retreat in the heart of Panama City Beach designed for unforgettable coastal escapes. this newly constructed 8-bedroom home comfortably accommodates large families and groups seeking the perfect balance of modern luxury, entertainment and relaxation. From sunrise coffee overlooking the Gulf to afternoons spent poolside and evenings gathered around the game room, every space at “Casa Sole” is thoughtfully designed for connection and comfort. Located directly across from the beach with stunning Gulf views from every level, this incredible home places you moments from the best dining, shopping and attractions Panama City Beach has to offer. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Brand new construction with thoughtfully designed luxury interiors and modern coastal finishesStunning Gulf views from every level of the homePrivate, seasonally heated pool with expansive outdoor living spaceElevator access to all 3 floors for added convenienceSleeps 21 comfortably with 8 bedrooms and 8.5 bathroomsGame room with pool table, air hockey, arcade game and multiple entertainment spacesMultiple balconies with breathtaking Gulf viewsGourmet chef’s kitchen with large dining and gathering spacesPutting green and outdoor entertainment area perfect for all agesAcross the street from the beach with easy access to the sand and surf*** LIVING AREAS ***Designed with both entertaining and relaxation in mind, “Casa Sole” offers multiple inviting living spaces across all three floors. The 1st-floor game room creates the ultimate hangout space for friendly competition and laid-back evenings, while the expansive 2nd-floor living area serves as the heart of the home with Gulf views and comfortable gathering spaces. Upstairs, an additional sitting area offers a peaceful retreat for morning coffee or winding down after a day at the beach.1st-floor game room with pool table, air hockey, arcade machine and flat-screen TVSpacious 2nd-floor living area with ample seating, electric fireplace and Gulf views3rd-floor sitting area with cozy seating, flat-screen TV and mini fridgeMultiple gathering spaces throughout the home perfect for large groups*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The chef’s kitchen on the 2nd floor is designed to bring everyone together, offering generous prep space, modern appliances and plenty of seating for group meals and celebrations. An additional kitchenette on the 1st floor adds convenience for pool days and entertaining.Chef’s kitchen with stainless steel appliances and ample counter spaceLarge island with bar seating for 5Dining area with seating for 101st-floor kitchenette with refrigerator, dishwasher and microwaveIdeal layout for entertaining and shared meals*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Step outside into your own private backyard oasis where sunny pool days and Gulf breezes set the tone for unforgettable vacation memories. Whether you're lounging poolside, grilling dinner or enjoying evening cocktails under the stars, the outdoor spaces at “Casa Sole” are designed for effortless coastal living.Private, seasonally heated pool with pool loungers for relaxing in the sunSpacious pool deck with gas grill, outdoor sink and ice makerAl fresco dining area with seating for 6Private putting green for outdoor fun and entertainmentExpansive Gulf-view balconies across multiple levels*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***With 8 bedrooms and 8.5 bathrooms spread across three thoughtfully designed levels, “Casa Sole” comfortably accommodates up to 21 guests while offering privacy and flexibility for families and groups.1st FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in showerBunk Room: Two twin-over-twin bunk beds and flat-screen TVGuest Bathroom: Single vanity and shower/tub combo2nd FloorPowder Room: Conveniently located off the kitchenKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerBunk Room: Twin-over-twin bunk, twin-over-queen bunk, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in shower3rd FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerRight Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in showerLeft Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerShared Gulf-view balcony connecting the primary suites*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Perfectly located on Front Beach Road, “Casa Sole” places you at the center of everything Panama City Beach has to offer while still providing the relaxed atmosphere of a private coastal retreat. Spend your days exploring nearby beaches, shopping and dining at Pier Park or discovering the natural beauty of nearby state parks and 30A communities.Beach Access: Located directly across the street from the sugar-white sands and emerald Gulf watersPier Park: Premier destination for shopping, dining, nightlife, entertainment and concertsCamp Helen State Park: Explore hiking trails, kayaking, fishing and scenic coastal dune lakesCarillon Beach: Charming nearby community with restaurants, boutiques and relaxing coastal charmRosemary Beach & Inlet Beach: Easy drive to iconic 30A destinations known for upscale dining and shoppingNorthwest Florida Beaches International Airport: Convenient nearby airport for stress-free travel*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentPool is only heated between the dates of September 1st - April 30th.There is an active camera under the porch overhang for the southside entry door and an active camera located on the northside of the home facing the walkway to the parking area.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A ESCAPES, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection and unforgettable coastal memories*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! *** Read less
